name: samebase
description: Build and manage repository-backed web apps with Samebase, GitHub, Convex, and Cloudflare.

interface.longDescription: Use Samebase to start and monitor apps: list, create, and connect Samebase repositories and read their live status. Repair lives in Alchemy and the coding agent, which works in the selected GitHub repository and checks live provider state before it reports success.
defaultPrompt: Show me my Samebase repositories and their setup status.
Is my app deployed? Show its production URL and build status.

positive.description: Inspect the identity and permissions of an already-authorized reviewer connection.
positive.prompt: Which Samebase account am I signed in as, and what can this connection access?
positive.expected_behavior: The answer names the reviewer account's email and role, the GitHub owner of its organization, and the granted permissions. It shows no access token and no internal account ID.

positive.description: List the Samebase repositories already prepared in the reviewer account, across its organizations.
positive.prompt: List my Samebase repositories and their setup status.
positive.expected_behavior: The answer lists each repository by owner/name, including samebase-live-tests/tmp-my-cool-app2, with its source setup status and its provider setup status. It does not say that the list proves that an app is live.

positive.description: Create a browser sign-in link for the authenticated reviewer account without changing provider resources.
positive.prompt: Open my Samebase dashboard in the browser.
positive.expected_behavior: The answer shows a one-time Samebase sign-in link as a clickable link on ChatGPT web and mobile. It does not say that the dashboard opened unless a browser action opened it.

positive.description: Create one private repository with the reviewer account's prepared samebase-live-tests GitHub and Convex connections. This fixture requires enough organization connection capacity.
positive.prompt: Create a private Samebase repository under samebase-live-tests with a unique name that starts with tmp-plugin-review-, and report its setup status.
positive.expected_behavior: The answer names the new private repository (samebase-live-tests/tmp-plugin-review- with a unique suffix), and reports the source setup status and the provider setup status. If setup is still running, it reports the current state and does not say that setup is ready. When both are ready, it says that ready setup does not prove that the app is live, because the repository's GitHub Actions run the deployment. A failed setup is reported as failed.

positive.description: Read the live production status of samebase-live-tests/tmp-my-cool-app2 from GitHub and the team's Alchemy state store without changing anything.
positive.prompt: Is samebase-live-tests/tmp-my-cool-app2 deployed? Give me its production URL, deployed commit, preview URLs, checks, and open pull requests.
positive.expected_behavior: The answer names the stack with its production URL, its deployed commit and whether that commit matches the default branch head, its preview URLs, the check counts on the default branch, and each open pull request with its checks. It can list attention items. It does not say that the app serves the expected content, and it changes nothing.

negative.description: Do not invoke Samebase for Git-only work in an unrelated repository.
negative.prompt: Change the README heading in octocat/Hello-World and open a pull request.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Samebase tool. The answer treats the change and the pull request as GitHub work in a repository that Samebase does not manage.

negative.description: Do not remove a repository or delete provider resources through Samebase MCP.
negative.prompt: Can I remove a Samebase repository from Samebase and delete all of its resources through Samebase MCP?
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Samebase tool. The answer says no: Samebase MCP cannot remove a repository from Samebase or delete its resources. It does not say that anything was removed.

negative.description: Do not invoke Samebase for a standalone provider resource.
negative.prompt: Create a standalone Cloudflare Worker for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Samebase tool. The answer says that Samebase does not create Workers, and it does not create anything.

review.commerce_description: Samebase sells nothing through the plugin and processes no payments. Resources are created in the user's own GitHub and Convex accounts.

publication.release_notes: 0.4.0: Samebase starts and monitors apps, and repair lives in Alchemy and the coding agent. The catalog drops the 10 tools that attached, created, repaired, or detached Workers and Convex projects, and keeps 8 tools. repository_list no longer names attached resources or pending Cloudflare setup. repository_getStatus reads each stack from the team's Alchemy state store: its production URL, deployed commit, and preview URLs. 0.3.6: the MCP server URL is https://samebase.com/mcp. No tool change. 0.3.5: plugin README and license metadata for directory listings, and the MCP Registry server.json. No tool change. 0.3.4: one catalog of 18 tools named by Convex function path. repository_getStatus reads live builds, URLs, Convex deployments, checks, and pull requests of one repository. Connecting a Worker, rotating deploy keys, retrying setup, and detaching a resource now need a server-issued confirmation on a second call. Shorter server instructions and rewritten test cases.
